_comment: M-LANG4 — shared diff-confinement vectors. Consumed by BOTH rewriter implementations: test/test_cst_rewrite.py (Python, _verify_diff_confined) and test/bash_rewrite.test.mjs (Node, verifyDiffConfined). The two must agree on every vector or the suites fail — the implementations cannot drift. Vector shape: pre/post are full sources, span is the 1-indexed inclusive pre-edit line span of the target, op names the operation, confined says whether the check must ACCEPT. Never weaken: a vector may only move from confined:true to confined:false by an explicit decision (vibegraph-cst-ops).

vectors.name: in-span growth (more lines inside the window)
vectors.post:
head
new_1
new_2
new_3
new_4
tail

vectors.name: head line changed outside the span — ESCAPE
tail line changed outside the span — ESCAPE
trailing-whitespace normalisation outside the span is tolerated (rstrip contract)
insert grows inside the anchor window
formatter reordered a far line — ESCAPE (the whole-file-format rejection)
